preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit() and len(line.split()) > 1])]
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer representing the number of cities.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the significance values A_i are integers between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(A) for A in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1]) <= 3 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((isinstance(val, int) and (val == -1 or val > 0)) for val in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdout_lines])
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer that is either -1 (impossible) or a positive integer (minimum total length).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda A, ans: (ans == -1) or (ans == sum(sorted([min(L for L in [1<<k for k in range(31) if (A[i] & A[j] & (1<<k)) == (1<<k)] if (A[i] & A[j]) > 0 else [float('inf')]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)) if (A[i] & A[j]) > 0])[:len(A)-1] if len([L for L in [1<<k for k in range(31) if (A[i] & A[j] & (1<<k)) == (1<<k)] if (A[i] & A[j]) > 0 else [float('inf')]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i+1, len(A)) if (A[i] & A[j]) > 0]) >= len(A)-1 else -1)) for A, ans in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1], [int(line.strip()) for line in stdout_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the cities can be connected, the output is the minimum total length of roads required to form a spanning tree where each edge (i, j) has weight equal to the smallest L > 0 such that (A[i] & A[j] & L) == L; otherwise, the output is -1.
